outcome: duration of active second stage of labor
mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal delivery, vacuum extraction, Cesarean section)
cohort: Nulliparous women at term with singleton pregnancies
finding: Ultrasound parameters, including AoP, PD, and HSD, measured at the beginning of the active second stage of labor, can predict the duration of the active second stage and differ significantly between fetuses delivering in the OP vs OA position.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly more common in fetuses delivering in the OP position compared to those delivering in the OA position.
